// SECURITY: The JWT signing key is intentionally NOT stored here. On startup the server uses the DAILYWORK_JWT_KEY environment variable when one is set; otherwise it generates a random key once and saves it to jwt-key.local.txt beside the executable, which .gitignore excludes. To set your own: setx DAILYWORK_JWT_KEY "a-long-random-value-of-at-least-32-characters"
// EMAIL: Real SMTP delivery requires Host, Port, Username, Password and From. Gmail: smtp.gmail.com, port 587, 2-Step Verification plus a 16-character App Password. Keep Password in an environment variable; never commit it here. Without SMTP credentials, messages are saved in the email-outbox folder.
